(5) City Government
Harristurg's governmental structure is based on that of the "Strong Mayor" concept of local government, with a seven-member city council. The Mayor is elected to a four year term. The organization of the various functioning components of the City is similar to many other cities of comparable size. The City's tax assessment function is handled by the County government.
Redevelopment activities are carried out by the Harrisburg Redevelopment Authority. Developed as a quasi-governmental body, this agency operates in close coordination with the City in planning and execution of its redevelopment activities.
(6) Housing
(a)Public
Public Housing in the City of Harrisburg is handled by another quasi-governmental agency, the Harrisburg Housing Authority. A total of 1,364 dwelling units are made available to City residents of low and moderate incomes through the agency. A number of the Housing Authority's units were damaged as a result of the storm. During the periods after the storm, when the demand on housing reached its peak, the Housing Authority received a total of 1,084 applications for temporary housing and it was able to provide temporary housing for approximately 695 families through various types of facilities which included a number of trailers. Discussed later in this report is a commitment by the Housing Authority to supply housing to displacees from the project area.
(b) Subsidized Housing
Approximately 773 dwelling units of Federally subsidized housing, Section 235, Section 236 and others, are now available to the project residents in both the City and the immediate surrounding area.
